draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: 2½S.B.: two full storeys and a half in the roof, read as gabled dormers in a hip over the post-1902 enlargement; the projecting tower/bay is T-1906's. The sheet traces the house and its rear range as one part, whose largest rectangle is a 47 m strip down the lot; the main body is fitted in front of the part's own break at 21.3 m from the rear lot line, where it narrows to the street front, and the rear range behind it.
